_doc: iter_018 v1: iter_015 v1 stack (T87 SPO+ NN + T75 LGB) + per-sym beta-calibrated abstain band wrapper from R_conformal_select. Models byte-identical to iter_015 v1; thresholds re-run via DE on combined stack (matches R_conformal_select baseline DE optimum). Wrapper: per-sym beta, sigma_pred precomputed from local val 442k. Verify total_loso = +41.4939 (delta +1.7473 over baseline +39.7467). Compliance: per-sym beta looked up by sym ID (allowed under CRITICAL_CONSTRAINTS - sym used as lookup key only, not fed to model.forward). Fallback beta=0.16 (mean) for OOD sym ID.
